specs.title: Paystack charge at booking
specs.why: Taking payment at booking time is what makes deposits and no-show protection possible.
specs.scope: Integrate Paystack: initialize transaction, redirect to checkout, verify on callback. Use Paystack subaccounts for tenant-level split payout.
specs.non_goals: Implement against the port with a recorded/stubbed adapter so tests pass without live Paystack credentials.
tasks: Booking transitions to `confirmed` on verified payment
Release the slot on failure after timeout
acceptance: A test-mode payment flips the booking to `confirmed`
A failed payment releases the slot within 10 minutes
No plaintext keys appear in logs

specs.title: Paystack webhooks
specs.why: Payment state must converge even when the customer closes the tab, which only webhooks guarantee.
specs.scope: Handler for `charge.success`, `charge.failed` and `refund.processed`. Verify signature, deduplicate, and update booking and payment state idempotently.
tasks: Idempotency key store with a 7-day TTL
acceptance: A replayed event is a no-op
All three event types update state correctly
